channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Opinion: CARE Court expansion exposes gap between legislation and reality
item.description: Expanding eligibility for California's CARE Court system without addressing structural flaws risks repeating the same mistakes at a larger scale.

item.title: How San Diego soccer could get an annual local rivalry like college basketball’s ‘City Championship’
item.description: San Diego soccer could get its own annual city rivalry match between San Diego FC and Albion San Diego, much like the "City Championship" that SDSU and University of San Diego's men's basketball teams play in each year.

item.title: The latest: US strikes Venezuela, captures Maduro and his wife
item.description: The lightning-fast American military action in Venezuela echoed the U.S. invasion of Panama in 1990.

item.title: Family of woman who died at Santee jail files wrongful death lawsuit
item.description: A lawsuit alleges jail staff knew of Callen Lines’ substance abuse history but failed to treat withdrawal before her May 12 death from fentanyl and meth.

item.title: Mega Millions jackpot rolls to $180 million after no big winner
item.description: There's still time to get rich as no ticket matched all six numbers in the latest Mega Millions drawing, sending the estimated jackpot climbing to $180 million for Tuesday’s draw.

item.title: San Diego has mixed reactions to U.S. military operation in Venezuela
item.description: Locals connected to Venezuela and members of San Diego's congressional delegation were among those responding to the military operation.

item.title: Balboa Park parking fees are almost here. How to avoid a ticket – and save a buck or two
item.description: A Balboa Park space will range from $2.50 to $16 as of Monday, depending on the spot or lot you're in and if you're a city resident.

item.title: Mustang strikes, kills man sitting in Oceanside median
item.description: Oceanside officers were summoned Friday evening to the intersection of Oceanside Boulevard and College Boulevard.

item.title: Waves, trick plays and eggnog chaos: The Holiday Bowl had it all
item.description: From a surfing snowman to the “Eggnog Dump” – with a daring trick play in-between – the Holiday Bowl was entertaining from beginning to end.

item.title: Misconduct derailed prosecution in Navy’s Fat Leonard scandal. Some defendants are seeking answers
item.description: The 'Fat Leonard' case, the Navy's largest corruption scandal, includes findings of prosecutorial misconduct. Two former officers want accountability.
